title: Smokey Bear and the U.S. wildfire prevention campaign, 1942–2024

sources.title: Smokey Bear turns 80 this year. Did he help prevent forest fires? (2024-08-09)
sources.license: NPR terms of use, all rights reserved (facts only)

facts.text: The Smokey Bear wildfire prevention campaign began in 1944 and is the longest-running public service campaign in U.S. history.
The campaign marked its 80th birthday in August 2024.
In 1942 a Japanese submarine fired shells at an oil field near Santa Barbara, California, close to Los Padres National Forest.
Officials feared that enemy shells could start forest fires along the Pacific coast, and many firefighters had been sent overseas during the war.
Records at the time showed that nine out of ten forest fires were caused by people.
Disney let the fire prevention program use its deer character Bambi on a poster, but only on loan for one year.
On 9 August 1944 the Forest Service and the Wartime Advertising Council agreed that a bear would be the fire prevention symbol.
The slogan Only You Can Prevent Forest Fires was first used in 1947.
In spring 1950 firefighters found a bear cub in a burned tree in the Capitan Mountains of New Mexico; his paws and hind legs were badly burned.
After treatment the cub was sent to the National Zoo in Washington, D.C., and became the living symbol of Smokey Bear.
Smokey received so much mail that he was given his own ZIP code.
For five decades the slogan suggested that all fires were preventable and harmful.
Indigenous peoples shaped and maintained many landscapes with fire; such planned burning is called prescribed or good fire.
Decades of putting out fires let plant growth build up, making many areas more likely to burn.
In 2001 the slogan became Only You Can Prevent Wildfires; a wildfire is any unwanted outdoor fire, including fires in grasslands.
The 2001 wording was meant to separate human-caused wildfires from beneficial prescribed fires.
About 80 percent of wildfires in the United States are caused by people.

notes: 選文數字對照：80 years（2024 年滿 80 年）、1942、1944、1947、1950（Three years later）、2001、80 percent。
